# Abra Intelligence

> Abra Intelligence is contextual AI for hands-on work. The right way to do the job lives in an SOP binder or in an expert's head; Abra brings it to the job: it sees what the worker sees, knows the procedure, and catches mistakes before they cost you. Smart glasses are one way to use it, not the product.

## How it works

- Context: give it the SOPs, manuals, expert voice notes and a recording of the job done right; set up in days, not months
- See: it sees the work through smart glasses, a phone or a body camera
- Catch: it flags a missed step, a wrong part or a leftover item in real time, and documents every step automatically
- Support, not surveillance: no individual performance scoring, the operator always decides

## Use cases

- Process monitoring: see whether SOPs are followed step by step and spot deviations as they happen
- Guided troubleshooting: context-based SOP guidance helps workers resolve disruptions faster
- Line clearance: detect remaining items and avoid contamination before the line restarts
- SOP generation: turn recordings of the real work into SOP drafts
- Worker safety: an alert before a safety-critical mistake happens, not after
- Hands-free documentation: speak the results and get the filled-in protocol
